plans.prompt: Slow push-in down an aisle of a small supermarket at night: the metal shelves on both sides are completely empty. A single fluorescent tube on the ceiling flickers. No people, no logos or readable text anywhere. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, slow push-in, moody low-key lighting, cold desaturated tones, film grain.

A long line of people under dark umbrellas waits in heavy rain in front of a closed, rusted factory gate, seen from behind; some wear plain solid orange work jackets. Faces not visible. No signs, no logos, no readable text, no flags. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, slow push-in, moody low-key lighting, cold desaturated tones, film grain.

First-person point of view, close-up on two young hands in dark suit sleeves, a plain gold wedding ring on the left hand, resting still on a dark wooden desk at night. An old beige CRT computer monitor in front of them casts a steady deep warning red glow over the hands and the desk; no readable text on screen. Rain streaks the window behind. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, slow push-in, moody low-key lighting, cold desaturated tones, film grain.

First-person point of view, close-up on a hand resting on a computer mouse on a dark wooden desk. A plain gold wedding ring and a wristwatch are clearly visible on the wrist. The hand presses the mouse button once. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, film grain.

A dim, empty hospital corridor at night, seen from the middle of the hallway. Warm ceiling lights switch on one by one in sequence down the corridor, pushing back the darkness. No people visible. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, slow push-in, moody low-key lighting, film grain.

Static frontal wide shot of a crowded classroom. Students sit at desks and more stand along the back wall. The front of the room, where a teacher would stand, is not visible. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, film grain.

Close-up on the hands of a supermarket stock clerk placing fresh unwrapped loaves of bread onto metal shelves, the aisle behind already full. Faces not visible, no packaging, no logos or readable text. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, warm bright interior light, film grain.

A large rusted factory gate rolls slowly open at sunrise. In front of it, a group of workers in plain solid orange work jackets stands waiting, seen from behind so no faces are visible; wet pavement shines in the low sun. No signs, no logos, no readable text, no flags. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, soft warm dawn light, film grain.

Wide shot of large wind turbines slowly spinning against a sunrise sky, warm golden light, open landscape, no people, no logos or text visible. Cinematic, slow push-in, shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, film grain.

Handheld camera with slight natural movement, inside a crowded bar at night on election night. People stand shoulder to shoulder, looking up and out of frame at an old television mounted high on the wall; its screen glows bright cold blue-white, no readable text or logos on screen. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, film grain.

Inside the same crowded bar, people erupt in celebration: confetti explodes and falls through the air, hands raised, phone lights glowing. No flags, no banners, no readable text anywhere in frame. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, moody low-key lighting, film grain.

First-person point of view standing at a tall window of a dark wood-paneled office in the morning. Only an older forearm in a dark suit sleeve and a hand wearing a plain gold wedding ring enter the frame from the lower right and pull a heavy curtain aside; bright sunlight pours in. No person, body or face visible, no reflection in the glass. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, bright warm natural daylight, film grain.

Wide shot of a sunny, lived-in city square: families walking, children running, a small open-air market with plain awnings without lettering, laundry on balconies, irregular old buildings, people doing different things. No flags, no banners, no signs, no readable text. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, bright warm natural daylight, film grain.

Aerial shot slowly gliding over a lived-in green city in daylight: irregular rooftops, wide parks full of people, tree-lined streets, asymmetric and organic layout. No flags, no flagpoles, no signs, no logos or readable text. Cinematic, bright warm natural daylight, film grain.

Static frontal wide shot of a bright classroom in daylight; every student sits at their own desk, a few desks remain empty. The front of the room is not visible. No readable text on walls or board. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, bright warm natural daylight, film grain.

A bright hospital corridor in daytime, seen from the middle of the hallway; a nurse in plain blue scrubs walks away from the camera. Face not visible. No signs or readable text. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, bright warm natural daylight, film grain.
Young people jump from a low wooden pier into a clean, clear river on a sunny day, splashing. No readable text. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, bright warm natural daylight, film grain.

Aerial shot in a slow forward glide over a wide green valley at sunrise: a lived-in small town with irregular red roofs, patchwork fields, and a train crossing a stone bridge over a river. No flags, no signs, no readable text. Cinematic, soft warm dawn light, film grain.

First-person point of view, medium close-up over a dark wooden desk in warm morning sunlight: an old beige CRT computer monitor fills the upper half of the frame, its screen glowing soft white with no readable text; in the foreground an elderly hand wearing a plain gold wedding ring rests still on a computer mouse. Behind, an open window with a white curtain moving gently in the breeze. Face not visible. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, bright warm natural daylight, film grain.

First-person point of view, same framing: medium close-up over a sunlit dark wooden desk, an old beige CRT monitor glowing soft white with no readable text in the upper half. The elderly hand with a plain gold wedding ring lets go of the computer mouse and slowly withdraws out of the bottom of the frame, leaving the mouse alone on the desk. Face not visible. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, bright warm natural daylight, film grain.
